comment_regular: Shared PP-lighting geometry/material setup. Oblivion parses NiProperty ID 2 name tokens here: exact 'Refract' sets passInfo 0x8000; exact 'RefractF' sets 0x10000, invalidates the cached pass key, enables refraction state, and clears conflicting alpha flag 1. Shared wrapper ownership proves Lighting30 and Hair inherit this parser.
